info.entry: This Max is the leader of a legion of heroes known as Crazy Cross. He is someone enthusiastic and likes to go on adventures around the world fighting against new creatures or people with advanced powers or abilities in order to be strong.
Kami is a somewhat rough lady against her opponents, but she has a noble heart. She is the leader's right hand from Crazy Cross Team to maintain order and protection for the team.
The antagonist of this story, a creature out of the ordinary with a thirst for damnation and destruction. A creature created with the aim of spreading pain, despair and destruction wherever it goes.

Max lost hope and now fights for his life to prevent Limerance from killing him or the South Police from arresting him for finding his friend dead in his house, Max uses Ethan's scarf so he can remember him forever as his best and great friend.

Rose sold her soul to Death (Universe 7) but without reading the fine print, she not only sold her soul... also her body as armor to be used by a demon named Limerance. Even having the body at the will of the demon... she has Rose's mind with desires to be together with Max no matter the consequences.

Car and his family consisting of his wife and son (Carla and Carlitos) live happily being guides for the player in case of problems or puzzles. Car is someone motivational and helpful, Carla is kind and friendly with the player and Carlitos does not talk much but with his tenderness inspires the player to continue playing.

This version of Max doesn't just exist for the sake of an adult TerminalMontage-style parody created by EstudiOmega, but to bring some cuteness and happiness to his friends. An unemployed Max with superpowers who lives with beautiful women and saving lives to pay for his home and life (scary, huh?).

Skarlet plushie came to life thanks to a FNF mod called: Graffiti Groovin directed by RechiTV (I love your art bro :3). She is Mini Max's faithful companion, every time Max feels sad, Skarlet plushie comes to give him some inspiration. (a cute character :3)

BB met GG at a hair salon, she was accompanied by her father DD and her mother Mimi. They agreed to go out for a walk until they fell in love with each other. From that moment on, they swore to be together forever, no matter the problems, in good times and bad. They faced many opponents together, they have lunch together, they bathe together, etc. They live together in a small house in the southern city next to Mini Max's apartment.
